faq.q: What does the name Aakifah mean?
faq.a: Aakifah means Woman devoted to worship (feminine of ʿākif).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aakifah?
What language does the name Aakifah come from?
faq.a: Aakifah is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aakifah a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aakifah is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aakifah written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aakifah is written عاكفة in Arabic and عاکفہ in Urdu, and आकिफ़ा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aakifah?
faq.a: The root of Aakifah is ع-ك-ف (ʿ-k-f).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aakifah?
faq.a: Feminine active participle of Arabic ʿakafa, 'to stay, to devote oneself'.

faq.q: Does Aakifah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not itself a Qur'anic personal name; the root ʿ-k-f and the practice of iʿtikāf are Islamic.
No. That gloss appears on some pages but is not supported; Aakifah is the feminine of ʿākif and means 'devoted to worship'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aakifah?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakifah total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aakifah?
faq.a: Aakifah appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Akifah, Aakifa.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aakifah?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aakifah include Aakif, Aakila.
Yes. Aakifah is the feminine of the masculine Aakif; both come from the root ʿ-k-f.

faq.q: Where is the name Aakifah used today?
faq.a: Aakifah is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
